name: Circuit-breaker function qualifier
summary: A breaker-function qualifier identifies automatic interruption capability in the compound representation.
description: A breaker-function qualifier identifies automatic interruption capability in the compound representation. The function element helps distinguish a breaker from other mechanically similar switching representations. Its associated protection may be shown as integrated releases or through a separately documented relay/trip circuit.
Record the breaker and trip interfaces consistently between the SLD and schematic. The function qualifier cannot replace the trip-unit or protection schedule.
readingNotes: Identify the actual trip functions and device schedule separately.
The qualifier does not specify thermal, magnetic or electronic trip details.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
Identify the actual trip functions and device schedule separately.
Cross-reference the equipment data, terminal mapping or operating-state legend needed to interpret the form.
distinction: The qualifier does not specify thermal, magnetic or electronic trip details.
